QuestInfo.name: [Carcion] Unstoppable Pursuit
QuestInfo.0: Eckhart's search has pointed the way to the kidnapped Anima. Make a plan to rescue them.
QuestInfo.1: Duhan wants to pursue the Snakes over rescuing the kidnapped Anima. As a compromise, you decided to split into a rescue team and a pursuit team.
QuestInfo.2: Gaon and Claudine took charge of the rescue team, while you and Eckhart decided to lead the pursuit team.
